comments.text:
This is game is like "Rhythm 0" which was a REAL performance art piece where Marina Abramović stood motionless for six hours in a gallery, presenting herself as a passive object. On a table next to her, there were 72 objects, ranging from harmless items (a rose, a feather, etc) to dangerous ones (scissors, a whip, a knife, a loaded gun with one bullet).

The audience was told they could use the objects on her however they wished, without consequences.

At first, people interacted gently, giving her flowers or kisses. But as time went on, the situation escalated, her clothes were cut off, her skin was cut and marked, someone put the gun in her hand and aimed it at her. Thankfully another audience member stopped that. She remained completely still and compliant throughout.
Everything possible was done to her body, it's genuinely insane and shows the nature of man.

And considering multiple people were playing this game...no wonder he went insane.
